scientific_sources.role: systematic mapping of AM-CMN experimental criteria
scientific_sources.finding: 123 mapped studies; nine met all five CMN-HC criteria
small and context-dependent effects; cautious interpretation and stronger control/power needed
13C/15N/D2O tracer observations; alternative pathways and incomplete control arms need explicit treatment

alignment.clocks: all non-reference clocks require calibration with a source-linked ClockSynchronization receipt
alignment.ordering: donor-before-bridge-before-receiver is accepted only for disjoint conservative time intervals

controls.matching: all required arms occur in each independent matched block

route_consistent_candidate_requires: all five fungal network criteria pass
cytoplasmic flow stream observed and source-linked
donor enrichment lower bound above receiver baseline
fungal bridge tracer enrichment lower bound above receiver baseline
receiver enrichment lower bound above baseline
intact receiver excess lower bound exceeds every control receiver excess upper bound in every matched block
inference.mass_reporting: do not report transferred elemental mass without measured total element pool mass and uncertainty

semantics.donor_baseline: Donor post-label atom fraction is compared with the same donor compartment's own pre-label baseline.
semantics.receiver_baseline: Receiver post-label atom fraction and matched control contrasts are compared with that arm's receiver pre-label baseline.
semantics.bridge: An intact-arm fungal-bridge post-label sample is mandatory for route-consistent status.
semantics.timing: Both donor and receiver baselines must be temporally before donor labelling; donor-to-bridge-to-receiver order must have disjoint conservative intervals.
semantics.bounds: Absolute error bounds are added conservatively; no independence or Gaussian assumption.
semantics.control_contrast: Within each matched block, intact receiver excess lower bound must exceed every required control receiver excess upper bound.
semantics.independent_blocks: At least three matched blocks; sample replicate IDs must remain distinct across arms and blocks.
semantics.route_claim: The highest outcome is a route-consistent evidence candidate, never a causal proof.

required_controls.alternative_ruled_out: residual/non-network pathway after interrupting fungal continuity
abiotic diffusion through the surrounding medium
plant/soil abiotic baseline without fungal inoculation
bacterial or other non-target microbial mediation
natural-abundance background, contamination or instrument artefact

claim_ceiling: A deterministic route-consistency screen using source-linked isotope observations and matched controls. It does not calculate statistical significance, estimate causal effects, prove direct fungal transport, or generalize beyond the experiment.
